name: Delicious Veggie Pot Soup
desc: A soup prepared by simmering a variety of shredded vegetables with light seasoning. Cooked with simple, minimal techniques, it brings out the purest essence of the vegetables. With just one sip, a comforting warmth spreads from your stomach through your entire body.

value.text: Restores 34% of Max HP and an additional 1,900 HP to the selected character.
